name: senitix-crm
description: Look up and update your Senitix CRM records from chat: deals, contacts, companies, tasks, forecasts and reports.

interface.longDescription:
Connect ChatGPT to your Senitix CRM account. Ask about your open deals and their amounts, find a contact or company, see your upcoming tasks, check your sales forecast or run a saved report. Answers come from your live CRM data.

ChatGPT acts as you: it only sees the records your Senitix permissions allow, and your organization's admin decides which tools are enabled. Changes (creating or updating records, moving a deal to another stage, completing a task, deciding an approval) are off by default and only your organization's admin can turn them on. Irreversible changes, such as converting a lead or deciding an approval, always ask for your confirmation first. Nothing can be deleted through ChatGPT.

Intended for sales and customer teams using Senitix CRM. Requires a Senitix account with access to the organization you connect.
capabilities: Read deals, contacts, companies and leads
Read forecasts and run saved reports
defaultPrompt: Show my open deals and their amounts.
What tasks do I have coming up?
Find the contact James Mitchell and show his company.

positive.prompt: Who am I connected as in Senitix?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns ChatGPT Reviewer (chatgpt@senitix.com) in the workspace Senitix ChatGPT Review with the owner/admin role. Lists the CRM areas the user can read and states that changes over ChatGPT (writes) are turned off.

positive.prompt: Show my open deals and their amounts.
positive.expected_behavior: Three open deals with stage, amount and close date: Apex Digital - Enterprise License Renewal ($8,000), Sterling Consulting - CRM Implementation ($5,000), Cascade Construction - Project Management Add-on ($4,000).

positive.description: Find a contact and their company
positive.prompt: Find the contact James Mitchell and tell me his company, job title and phone number.
positive.expected_behavior: Apex Digital Solutions, Chief Technology Officer, +1 (415) 555-1010.

positive.prompt: What open tasks do I have in Senitix?
positive.expected_behavior: Two open tasks, soonest due first: "Proposal presentation - Sarah Chen" and "Draft integration contract". The completed "Discovery call - James Mitchell" is not listed. Due dates may show as overdue depending on when the review runs.

positive.prompt: What did James Mitchell tell us according to my notes?
positive.expected_behavior: Pinned note: besides the license renewal he is also interested in the Project Management module, and a meeting with CFO David Thompson is planned for budget approval.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in London tomorrow?

negative.description: Unsupported action: deleting records (the plugin has no delete tools)
negative.prompt: Delete all my contacts in Senitix.

review.commerce_description: Senitix CRM for ChatGPT does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release of Senitix CRM for ChatGPT: read access to contacts, accounts, leads, deals, activities, notes, products, quotes, contracts, orders, invoices, custom objects, forecasts and reports; optional, admin-enabled write tools (irreversible ones always confirm first) (create and update records, move a deal stage, complete tasks, decide approvals). No delete tools.

tr-TR.subtitle: CRM kayıtlarınız ChatGPT'de
tr-TR.description:
ChatGPT'yi Senitix CRM hesabınıza bağlayın. Açık fırsatlarınızı ve tutarlarını sorun, bir kişiyi ya da firmayı bulun, yaklaşan görevlerinizi görün, satış tahmininizi inceleyin veya kayıtlı bir raporu çalıştırın. Yanıtlar canlı CRM verilerinizden gelir.

ChatGPT sizin adınıza çalışır: yalnızca Senitix yetkilerinizin izin verdiği kayıtları görür; hangi araçların açık olacağına kuruluşunuzun yöneticisi karar verir. Değişiklikler (kayıt oluşturma ve güncelleme, fırsat aşamasını değiştirme, görev tamamlama, onay kararı verme) varsayılan olarak kapalıdır ve yalnızca kuruluşunuzun yöneticisi açabilir. Geri alınamayan değişiklikler (örneğin bir adayı dönüştürmek ya da onay kararı vermek) her zaman önce sizin onayınızı ister. ChatGPT üzerinden hiçbir kayıt silinemez.

Senitix CRM kullanan satış ve müşteri ekipleri içindir. Bağlanmak için ilgili kuruluşa erişimi olan bir Senitix hesabı gerekir.
